title: Tamsin and the Gravity
author: Coral Thackeray
blurb: Freya Almeida, an insurance investigator of impossible accidents, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
